title: Deliver Coal to Sonham Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Sonham Power Station** (industry id 1, near tile 142,200).

A likely supplier is **Sonham Coal Mine** (industry id 26, near tile 162,195); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **260 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
